title: File Size Converter
h1: File Size Converter — Bytes, KB, MB, GB
seoTitle: Free File Size Converter — KB to MB, GB to Bytes
description: Convert between bytes, KB, MB, GB, TB and more. Supports binary (1024) and decimal (1000) systems. Instant and private.
intro: Enter a value and choose units to convert file sizes. Toggle between binary and decimal bases.
blurb: Convert file sizes across units with binary or decimal bases.
howItWorks: Enter the number and select source and target units.
Choose binary (powers of 1024) or decimal (powers of 1000).
examples: 1024 KB in binary is exactly 1 MB.

Use binary for actual file sizes on computers, decimal for advertised storage.
